style: Bold body-shop flat vector illustration in workshop black (#1a1a1a), body-shop red (#ff4f3d) and white, crisp shapes with subtle spray-paint speckle, no text.

subjects.debosselage-peinture: A car door panel on a stand, half repaired: one side showing a dent being worked with a dent-repair hammer and dolly, a spray gun hanging nearby. No hands, no people.
subjects.antirouille-gs: The underside of a car on a lift being sprayed with a protective oil coating, a spray wand in view. No hands, no people.
subjects.restauration-epoque: An old generic boxy classic car of no identifiable make (invented design, rounded fenders, no badges, no chrome lettering) partly sanded to bare metal in a workshop, masking paper on the windows. No people.
subjects.carrosserie-fibre: A fibreglass car hood on a workbench with a patched repair area, a roll of fibreglass mat and a resin can beside it.
subjects.peinture-camion: A generic pickup truck in a paint booth with masking on the windows and a spray gun on a hook. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A combined repair and body shop interior: a car on a lift, a second car with masking tape on a panel in a paint area, a spray gun on a hook, an older classic-style car under a cover. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK black overall, body-shop red highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
